library.description: Marine Corps aviation command and control. Fuses expeditionary radar, weapon-system, UAS and ISR inputs into one MAGTF air picture and hosts the engage / do-not-engage decision. Named by CRS as the C2 element of the Marine MRIC air-defence system alongside G/ATOR.

library.name: Red air: Geran-4 jet OWA (G3)
library.description: Turbojet one-way-attack from the Geran-3/4/5 jet family, per threat study 5.2.1 [R03]: 450 kg MTOW, 89 m/s (320 km/h) cruise, 770 km range, thermobaric or HE-frag warhead types identified. The study fixes no Geran-3 numbers, so the exploited Geran-4 carries the jet-OWA class.

uas.emissionsNote: SADRA INS + 16-element CRPA anti-jam satnav, camera, mesh modem (study [R03])

provenance.value: 350 to 500 km/h cruise; the lower bound is 97 m/s

threatProfile.routeIntent: High-speed deep strike; compressed detect-to-engage timeline

library.name: Red air: Bayraktar TB2 UCAV (G4)
library.description: MALE UCAV per threat study 15B [TUR02]: 700 kg MTOW, 150 kg payload, 46 m/s (90 kt) cruise, 16000 ft operational altitude, 20+ h endurance. Releases laser-, INS/GPS-, or IR-guided munitions and mini cruise missiles at standoff; the study publishes no release range, so the standoff value is a planning factor.

uas.emissionsNote: LOS and BLOS datalinks; EO/IR/laser designator or surveillance radar (study [TUR02])
uas.rangeNote: LOS and BLOS communications per the 2026 Baykar sheet; no public radius figure used.

provenance.value: 16000 ft operational altitude, 20000 ft service ceiling

threatProfile.routeIntent: Persistent medium-altitude ISR/strike orbit with standoff munition release

systemPresets.name: FS-LIDS fixed site (LIDS class)
systemPresets.description: US Army fixed-site layered defense: four RPS-42 faces for 360 deg acquisition, KuRFS fire control, EO/IR identification, EW defeat, and Coyote interceptors under FAAD C2.

components.purpose: Non-kinetic EW defeat for small targets

systemPresets.name: MEROPS counter-OWA site
systemPresets.description: Counter-Shahed package: early-warning radar plus a forward acoustic line cue fixed-wing MEROPS interceptors through an expeditionary C2 node.

components.purpose: Fuses radar and acoustic tracks; vectors interceptors

systemPresets.name: Acoustic picket IADS (Sky Fortress class)
systemPresets.description: Acoustic-led layered defense with its own geometry: a wide forward picket line of cheap omni microphone nodes gives minutes of warning; a fusion node cues a short-range tracking radar and mobile gun trucks plus a jammer.

systemPresets.name: Distributed sensor mesh (Legion/Lattice class)
systemPresets.description: Expeditionary mesh of mixed small sensors (passive RF, compact radar, acoustic, sensor tower) feeding edge C2 nodes; graceful degradation when any node drops out.

components.purpose: Acoustic fill for RF-silent and low threats
Acoustic fill for RF-silent and low threats
Autonomous tower watching the rear sector
Gateway into the theater air picture
Kinetic defeat cued by the edge nodes

systemPresets.name: M-LIDS Increment 2 section (two-vehicle M-ATV)
systemPresets.description: US Army mobile LIDS section: a kinetic vehicle carrying the masted KuMRFS-M radar, the RIwP turret with 30 mm and Coyote, and an EW vehicle carrying CUAEWS direction finding and jamming, both on FAAD C2. Component list follows the SRC LIDS Family of Systems brochure. Offsets inside a vehicle are drawing separation, not real geometry.

components.purpose: Masted KuMRFS-M: 360 deg surveillance and fire control at the short halt
RIwP stabilised sight: identification and auto-track through the engagement
RIwP XM914E1 30 mm: close-in kinetic defeat, final protective fire
RIwP Coyote launcher: longer-range kinetic defeat
FAAD C2, kinetic vehicle: engagement operations and fratricide prevention
EW vehicle: passive RF lines of bearing to the UAS and its operator
EW vehicle: non-kinetic defeat, control-link and navigation denial
FAAD C2, EW vehicle: same air picture over the section network

systemPresets.name: M-LIDS Increment 2.1 (single Stryker)
systemPresets.description: US Army single-vehicle LIDS: CRS records Increment 2.1 consolidating sensors and weapons on one Stryker with the Raytheon XBAEU radar rather than KuRFS. No public range figure exists for XBAEU, so its ring is a planning figure. Offsets are drawing separation, not real geometry.

components.purpose: Masted XBAEU Ku-band AESA: 360 deg surveillance and fire control
RIwP stabilised sight: identification and auto-track
RIwP XM914E1 30 mm: close-in kinetic defeat
RIwP Coyote launcher: longer-range kinetic defeat
FAAD C2 on the vehicle: engagement operations and fratricide prevention

systemPresets.name: MADIS Increment 1 section (Mk1 + Mk2)
systemPresets.description: REPRESENTATIVE LAYDOWN - NOT A VERIFIED FIELD CONFIGURATION. USMC ground-based air defense section: a Mk2 sensor and non-kinetic vehicle paired with a Mk1 kinetic vehicle. CRS states only that the Mk2 carries radar plus kinetic and non-kinetic counter-UAS capability; the specific radar, jammer and C2 shown here are the nearest library equivalents, not sourced attributions.

components.purpose: Mk2 EO/IR: visual identification on radar cue
Marine aviation C2 node: air picture for the section
Mk1 XM914E1 30 mm on the remote weapon station
Mk1 Stinger: missile layer of the kinetic vehicle

systemPresets.name: L-MADIS section (two ULTV, non-kinetic)
systemPresets.description: USMC light MADIS: a sensor ULTV carrying four RPS-42 faces and an EO/IR camera, paired with a second ULTV carrying the Modi jammer. Components follow CRS. The RPS-42 detects and cues the operator, who engages with Modi on the section; no networked C2 node is placed because no source names one on an L-MADIS vehicle.

components.purpose: CM262 EO/IR: visual identification on radar cue
Modi on the second ULTV: control-link denial, dismountable

systemPresets.description: REPRESENTATIVE LAYDOWN - NOT A VERIFIED FIELD CONFIGURATION. Four 50 kW laser prototypes shown cued by an accompanying SGT STOUT vehicle over FAAD C2. The DE vehicle own sensor fit is not public and this cueing chain is a planning arrangement. GAO found the prototype not mature enough to transition; it remains a prototype.

systemPresets.name: Point defense, balanced fires (doctrinal)
systemPresets.description: REPRESENTATIVE LAYDOWN - NOT A VERIFIED FIELD CONFIGURATION. Doctrinal point defense of a single asset: a search radar hands to a fire-control radar, passive RF and EO/IR confirm, and FAAD C2 offers a soft-kill and two kinetic layers. Ranges and spacings are planning figures, not doctrinal distances: no public C-UAS doctrine publishes a laydown geometry.

components.purpose: Search layer: early warning on the threat axis
Passive RF: non-emitting detection and operator location
EO/IR: visual identification before the engagement decision
Track fusion, identification and engagement management
Soft-kill layer: attempted first where the rules of engagement allow
Inner kinetic layer: final protective fire

systemPresets.name: Layered base defense, weighted coverage (doctrinal)
systemPresets.description: REPRESENTATIVE LAYDOWN - NOT A VERIFIED FIELD CONFIGURATION. Doctrinal layered defense of a base: coverage is weighted toward the threat axis rather than spread evenly, longer-range search hands to local acquisition, and the defense keeps a non-kinetic and a kinetic option on every track. Geometry is a planning figure.

components.purpose: Long-range air surveillance on the threat axis
Wide-area IR: rear-sector fill and visual confirmation
Base defense air picture and engagement management
Inner gun layer: final protective fire over the base

systemPresets.name: Maneuver protection on the move (doctrinal)
systemPresets.description: REPRESENTATIVE LAYDOWN - NOT A VERIFIED FIELD CONFIGURATION. Doctrinal protection of a moving element: sensors and effectors travel with the formation, the air picture is thinner than at a fixed site, and the defense trades coverage for mobility. Spacings are a representative march interval, not a doctrinal distance.

components.purpose: Mobile acquisition radar, forward of the element
Mobile passive RF: bearings to the UAS and its operator
Mobile C2: air picture and fratricide prevention on the move
Missile layer travelling with the column
Non-kinetic defeat travelling with the column

testCards.customerQuestion: Can the system detect and stop a low, slow quad before it crosses the wall?
testCards.purpose: Assess DTI and defeat of small drones delivering contraband over a perimeter.
testCards.threatProfile: G1 quad, 30-300 ft AGL, short standoff launch, frequent hovers
testCards.covariates: surface wind 9 m/s from 0 deg; visibility / cloud base (clear); air temp 15 C / dew point; pressure QNH/QFE; illuminance (day); EM background avg/peak (urban); acoustic background avg/peak
measures: First detection range and time per sensor
